description: Angular component for editing and managing a list of architecture items (title, type, links) with add, edit, delete functionalities.

classes.name: ArchitectureComponent
classes.description: Angular component class for managing architecture items list, including add, edit, delete, and change detection.

methods.name: hasUnsavedChanges
methods.description: Checks if there are any unsaved changes in the add or edit forms.

methods.name: startAdd
methods.description: Initializes the form to add a new architecture item.

methods.name: confirmAdd
methods.description: Adds a new architecture item if the title is provided.

methods.name: beginEdit
methods.description: Starts editing an existing architecture item.

methods.name: saveEdit
methods.description: Saves the edited architecture item if the title is provided.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an architecture item by id.
